doc.title: Junior Mance Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Verve reissue of the Adderley sessions
summary: Mance mentions the Adderley connection; Verve is reissuing the Cannonball and Nat albums and he checks credits.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Tell us, you did some work with the Adderleys.
Yeah. I was in the Army with Cannonball, Cannonball and Nat.
First of all I got to say if I had to pick a quintet that just to me had a beautiful jazz feeling and a beautiful soul feeling it would be the Cannonball quintet.
